_comment: Claude Desktop / Cursor MCP server configuration for A2CN negotiation tools.

env._comment_optional: Set A2CN_COUNTERPARTY_SERVER_DID to skip discovery and hardcode the JWT audience

a2cn-http._comment: Alternative: HTTP transport for LangGraph / remote frameworks.

_setup: 1. Replace PATH_TO with the absolute path to this repository.
2. Set A2CN_AGENT_DID to a DID you control (e.g. did:web:yourdomain.com).
— run: python mcp_server.py to print the generated DID document.
4. Copy this file content into your Claude Desktop config:
'Negotiate a SaaS renewal with did:web:acme-corp.com for $95,000/year.
My ceiling is $110,000. Offer net-30 terms. Accept if they come below $105K.'
